records.name: Stone Grimace

contract.movement: Stationary, solid room hazard; no pursuit or ordinary body-contact damage.
contract.targeting: Player position for aimed attacks; orientation-specific hazards retain authored facing.
contract.vulnerability: Immune to ordinary damage; solid to player movement even with flight. Chaos Card, Little Horn and Euthanasia are documented instant-kill exceptions. Generally respawns on room re-entry after such kills; Stone Eye has a distinct cleared-room re-entry rule. Generic XML HP is not ordinary damageability.
contract.phases: Active until ordinary combat completion or all required pressure plates are pressed; then closes mouth/eyes and stops firing.
contract.offspring: No ordinary enemy offspring. Infestation 2 can create a Blue Spider on an exceptional kill; separate item dependency.
contract.completion: Does not seal doors. Room completion disables shooting without requiring its death; retain the inactive appearance on re-entry.
contract.adaptations: No new runtime behavior or stage enablement in this review. Future 3D silhouette, obstacle footprint, projectile heights and timing must be declared DeathWard adaptations. Hazard placement needs its own budget and must not count as a kill-required enemy.
contract.unknowns: Exact native projectile speed, firing interval/selection, collision shape and effect-specific status/timing exceptions are not established. Pressure plates, instant-kill items, reroll behavior, re-entry and projectile-hit item hooks need concrete runtime support and tests. Named Dead Eye and Fire Mind projectile-hit behavior must be preserved despite ordinary invulnerability.
